title: Localized bounded Multi-Site API error recovery copy
opportunity: Multi-Site API errors exposed English ProblemDetails title/detail text directly, so operators received internal wording instead of a clear Thai recovery action.
rootCause: readApiError ignored the stable ProblemDetails code and had no bounded user-facing copy map.
implementation: Added a bounded apiErrorCopy map for operational Multi-Site codes, including mutation contention, health-summary timeout, activation failure, database availability, hostname conflict and version conflicts.
Preserved validation error detail for actionable field-level feedback and kept the generic RFC7807 fallback path.
Read only the stable code and extensions.code fields, cap the final message at 512 characters, and do not expose traceId or infrastructure details.

tdd.red: BrowserMultiSiteErrorCopyContractTests initially failed because readApiError had no detail.code mapping.

verification.relevantRegression: 81/81 across 38 classes; direct-listener SiteHealthProbeTests were excluded because the current execution environment returns socket_AccessDenied for the loopback fixture.
verification.impeccableDetector: passed with four pre-existing advisory color findings (#ff4d5e, #22374f, #ff6378); no new error-copy finding
verification.uiAuditBoundary: copy-only browser refinement; no CSS/HTML visual assets changed; existing UI audit baseline retained

boundaries: Authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, live PostgreSQL behavior, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
